title: Defensive checks, defaults, and guard clauses
hook: Optional chaining stops crashes but does not prove data shape. Guard clauses, explicit validation at API boundaries, and nullish defaults form the production pattern senior interviews expect after JSON.parse.

blocks.text: **Guard clauses** return early when preconditions fail — keeping happy path unindented. **Boundary validation** checks JSON.parse and fetch results before use. **Nullish defaults** with ?? preserve 0 and "". **Fail fast** throws typed errors when invariants break instead of propagating undefined. Layer: syntax (?., ??) for ergonomics; guards for correctness.

entries.plainDefinition: Validate external data at entry to system.
Condition that must always hold for correct operation.
Reject bad input immediately with clear error.

blocks.text: TypeScript types erase at run time — JSON.parse returns any shape. Silent undefined from ?. causes wrong business logic (discount 0%). C# validates more at compile time; JS services need runtime guards at controllers and message consumers.

blocks.title: Validate once at the edge
blocks.body: Parse and validate at HTTP handler or queue consumer — inner functions assume typed shape.

diagram.title: Boundary to domain
diagram.source:
flowchart LR
  API[HTTP / queue] --> V[Validate shape]
  V -->|fail| E[400 + error]
  V -->|ok| D[Domain logic]
  D --> G[Guard clauses]
  G --> H[Happy path with ?? defaults]

snippet.label: Guard clauses
snippet.explanation: Early returns flatten logic. Each guard names failure reason for API response.

snippet.label: JSON boundary validation
snippet.explanation: Required fields validated explicitly. Optional fields use ?? not || for name default.

snippet.label: Failure mode — silent ?.
snippet.explanation: ?. on inner fields does not guard required top-level user — guard clause first.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Relying on ?. for required fields. Skipping validation because TypeScript compiled. Deep nesting instead of guards. Using || defaults when 0 is valid. Swallowing validation errors without structured response.

interviewTakeaways: Validate external data at boundary — TS does not run at runtime.
Guard clauses flatten happy path with early return/throw.
Use ?? for defaults; ?. for optional nested paths only.
Fail fast with typed errors — not silent undefined.
60s: JSON.parse any shape. Guard at edge. ?. ergonomics not proof. ?? preserves 0. TS erased.
commonPitfalls: Weak: "Optional chaining validates APIs." Strong: "?. prevents throw; guards prove shape at boundary."
Weak: "TypeScript makes runtime checks unnecessary." Strong: "Types erase — validate JSON.parse always."
Strong: "Show charge vs chargeSafe — required user needs guard not only ?."

jsTsCorrelations.note: Use zod/io-ts at boundaries; TypeScript interfaces do not exist at run time.
C# throws ArgumentNullException on null params; JS convention: throw TypeError early in public APIs.
